$description: Design tokens extracted from upakenigma.com (ODO «ENIGMA», Mogilev, Belarus) on 2026-11-11. Values are computed styles measured in headless Chromium at a 1440 px viewport unless a description says otherwise. Tokens under color.a11y are suggested substitutes and are NOT used by the live site. Format loosely follows the W3C Design Tokens draft ($type / $value). Regenerate tokens.css with: python3 scripts/build_tokens.py

bright.$description: Primary-button gradient top and hover fill; product-card titles

base.$description: Nav bar, active category chip, 'узнать подробнее' (learn more) bar on cards

deep.$description: Nav item hover, quick-view bar hover

ring.$description: Ring bullets in the hero list

link.$description: Underlined text links, breadcrumbs, news titles, e-mail links

icon.$description: Stroke of the raster line icons (benefits, steps)

divider.$description: 1 x 16 px separators between nav items

mint.$description: Idle category chips and the 'Заказать звонок' (request a call) button

teal.$description: Hexagon outlines and arrows in 'Как мы работаем' (raster sprite icons-steps1.png)
Secondary text: cards, news, steps, spec table, lead line

white.$description: Text on green and on the hero video

tint.$description: Card footer band, page-title band, 10 px certificate frames

input.$description: Text inputs and the search field

row.$description: Spec-table cells (separated by 1 px white lines)

newsRule.$description: 28 x 2 px rule under news titles

bullet.$description: 8 px ring bullets in the footer link list

errorRing.$description: 3 px ring on an invalid input

green.$description: SUGGESTED. Closest green to the brand with 5.07:1 against white, for text, links and button fills

button.$description: Primary button fill, top to bottom

sans.$description: The live site self-hosts the commercial Museo Sans Cyrl. Golos Text is a free stand-in that is not on the live site

thin.$description: Live site maps this to the MuseoSansCyrl-100 file

regular.$description: Live site maps this to the MuseoSansCyrl-500 file: two @font-face rules claim 400 and the later one wins

medium.$description: No 500 face is declared, so this falls back to the 400 face

display.$description: Hero title (white with text-shadow) and the H1 of inner pages

stepNumber.$description: White digit on the green hexagon badge

lead.$description: Thin lead line under the process steps, with a bold phrase

heroBullet.$description: Hero list items, white with text-shadow

body.$description: Default text, nav, inputs, SEO copy

container.$description: Fixed-width .w-center container, centred (135 px side margins at 1440)

gutter.$description: Gap in the 3-column product grid (3 x 370 + 2 x 30 = 1170)

productCard.$description: Product card width; image area 368 x 250, footer band 100 px

logoWidth.$description: Logo 155 x 48 in header and footer

inputHeight.$description: Form inputs and full-width submit button

chipHeight.$description: Category chips and the call-request button

button.$description: Inset bottom edge on primary buttons (brownish, rgba(167,83,0,.3))

errorRing.$description: Added to shadow.input on an invalid field

textHero.$description: text-shadow on hero text over video

xs.$description: max-width: container 330 px, process steps hidden

md.$description: max-width: container 500 px, one column, stacked menu

lg.$description: max-width: minor tweaks. At tablet-portrait widths (768-834) the 968 px container is wider than the screen and is clipped

xl.$description: max-width: container 968 px (1000 px between about 900 and 1024), two products per row, search hidden
